title: Variation Spaces for Encoder--Decoder Neural Operators: Approximation and Generalization
summary: Inspired by the function-space theory of neural networks, we formulate and analyze a variation space for nonlinear operators between Hilbert spaces, defined through vector-valued Borel measures of bounded variation. We characterize its unit ball as the closed convex hull of a vector-valued single-neuron dictionary in Bochner spaces. For the ReLU activation, the bounded linear operators in this space are precisely the Schatten-$1$ operators, with equivalent norms.
